headings.usage: H1, H2, H3. Never use Inter or generic sans for headings. This establishes the 'Modern Newspaper' editorial feel.

body.usage: Paragraphs, metadata, UI chips, buttons. This provides the 'Linear Polish' contrast.

colors.strategy: High-Contrast Swiss Editorial. Monochromatic base with a single restrained accent.

accent.rules: Restrained accent color for category chips, NEW badges, and active links ONLY. NO rainbow gradients.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px borders (border-border/60) on cards to create an 'archival index' technical look.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Omit large shadows. Rely on sharp borders for container definition. Use shadow-sm on hover.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 for sticky headers and sticky filter chips. Ensure a 1px border separates it from content.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise/grain background layer to kill digital flatness and enhance the editorial feel.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, and gap-8 to give text room to breathe.
grids_and_layouts.mobile: Thumb-friendly cards. Ensure main container has overflow-x-hidden to prevent horizontal scrolling.
grids_and_layouts.story_feed: Dense high-contrast grid. 12-column layout. TL;DR spans full width, regular stories span 1 column on mobile, 1/2 or 1/3 on desktop.

components_instructions.tldr_hero_card: The flagship component. Must look like a premium digital newspaper snippet. Use a dark/tinted abstract background image with a gradient overlay (bg-black/40). Include 'Today in AI', a 5-bullet summary, timestamp, and a prominent 'Share' button.
components_instructions.category_chips: Sticky horizontal scrollable row (hide scrollbar). Pill shaped `rounded-full`, 1px border. Active state uses the accent color.
components_instructions.story_card: Minimalist card. Playfair Display for headline. Display rank number prominently (e.g., large light gray number). Include relative time, source count, and a NEW/UPDATED badge.
components_instructions.search_bar: Sleek input field with a '/' keyboard shortcut badge.
components_instructions.story_detail: Editorial reading mode. H1 headline, short summary, list of outbound source links. Share buttons.
components_instructions.newsletter: Inline block with simple email input and 'Subscribe' button. High contrast.

motion.interactions: Subtle hover states (-translate-y-1) for story cards. Hover colors must explicitly be defined (e.g., hover:border-accent).
motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders with pulse animation for incoming data. No spinning circles.
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions like `transition-transform duration-200 ease-out`. Avoid `transition-all`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients meets APCA standards.
accessibility.focus: All buttons and inputs need focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:outline-none.

image_urls.description: Dark blue/black minimal abstract. Apply as masked background for the TL;DR Hero Card.
Monochrome newspaper stack. Use for About page hero or fallback.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
Left-align paragraphs, inputs, or dense content for readability.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.

instructions: You are writing .js/.jsx files (not .tsx) for the frontend.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions. Use Shadcn components for Select, Dialog, etc.
Never center-align the main app container in CSS.
Add 'data-testid' to EVERY button, link, and major UI section.
Avoid AI slop: do not use rainbow gradients or emoji icons. Stick to lucide-react icons.
Dark mode by default, support toggling.
